descStruct.summary: **球状星団アナロジー —— アナロジーの第 1 段**(第283便f・原仮定者の裁定〔第72報〕⑥「geoPN=3・中心にスケール調整した DFM 版 BH・球状星団 → 楕円 → 渦巻 → 棒渦巻・質量合わせは恒星質量ダークローター」)。physics は 🌚 と同じ(geoPN=3・kFrame=0・physics.spaceMesh の lawVersion:"scalar"・η=1・ε=3・frameWeight:"share"・centerSpin:"read")で、違いは 3 つ: ① 恒星 170 体(M★=53.125)と恒星質量ダークローター(DR)の代表粒子 40 体(M_DR=2125 —— ⟨m_DR⟩=1 M☉ が代表・M_DR/M★=40 は 🌚 と同じ台帳の比)を**同じ Plummer 分布**(投影尺度 10・切断半径 R_out=40)に置き、初速は行ごとのビリアル平衡(等方・回転なし) ② 中心 DFM 版 BH を**スケール調整**した(m=250・R=1.5・spin=12 —— GM/(Rc²)=0.148・ΩR/c=0.600 は 🌚 と同じ・M_center/(M★+M_DR)=0.115 は 🌚 の 1/10) ③ **背景の重み W_bg を physics.spaceMesh.D0=1.5 に明示**した(出どころ "declared" —— D₀ を流用しない)。働くのは重力(E4)と geoPN=3 のトイ(座標慣性・中心の自転を読む)。**f=1**。DR の代表粒子は `massLedger.darkRotor.lens:"excluded"` により**光線の源から外れる**(重力の源は不変)。**形状の門は測る前に宣言した**(PHYSICS〔第283便f〕)。**言わないこと**: 47 Tuc を再現した/観測一致を達成した/形状が安定した。
descStruct.observe: 実測(器 tests/exp-w283f-cluster.mjs・正本 tests/out/cluster-w283f.json・dt=0.016): 窓 [T_relax, T_end]=[1, 3]×T_out(外縁 R_out=40 の公転時間)で、NaN・保持率(r ≤ 2R_out・恒星と DR 別)・恒星の半質量半径の変化・軸比(1/r² 重みの慣性テンソル)・|v_rot|/σ・トイの帳簿を 0.25 T_out ごとに測り、門の語(形状達成/未達)で書く。対照: 中心 spin 0・DR なし・N_rep 80/160(DR の総質量一定)。**言わないこと**: 47 Tuc を再現した/形状が安定した。
descStruct.brief: 中心 DFM 版 BH と恒星質量ダークローターを同じ Plummer 分布に置いた球状星団アナロジー。未達・測る前に宣言した形状の門で未達(保持率・半質量半径・軸比)。較正対象外。
descStruct.control: ワンタップ対照A/B: B 側は**中心の spin=0**(同じ配置・同じ opt-in —— 中心の自転の寄与だけを外す)。比較の相手は 🌚(同じ physics・同じ台帳の比の銀河アナロジー)と 🍇🫐(47 Tuc の観測転写・DFM 版 —— 単位も初期化も違う)。**kFrame は動かさないこと**(geoPN=3 の入場条件)。

descStruct.summary: GLOBULAR-CLUSTER ANALOGY - THE FIRST STAGE of the analogy series (wave 283f, the originator's ruling in report 72, item 6: geoPN=3, a scaled DFM black hole at the centre, globular cluster -> elliptical -> spiral -> barred spiral, mass matched by stellar-mass dark rotors). The physics is 🌚's (geoPN=3, kFrame=0, spaceMesh lawVersion scalar, eta=1, eps=3, frameWeight share, centerSpin read) with three differences: (1) 170 stars (M_star=53.125) and 40 representative particles of stellar-mass dark rotors (M_DR=2125 - <m_DR>=1 Msun representative, M_DR/M_star=40 as in 🌚's ledger) sit ON ONE PLUMMER PROFILE (projected scale 10, cut at R_out=40) with per-row virial velocities (isotropic, no rotation); (2) THE CENTRAL DFM BLACK HOLE IS SCALED (m=250, R=1.5, spin=12 - GM/(Rc^2)=0.148 and Omega R/c=0.600 as in 🌚, M_c/(M_star+M_DR)=0.115, 1/10 of 🌚); (3) THE BACKGROUND WEIGHT W_bg IS DECLARED as physics.spaceMesh.D0=1.5 (source label 'declared' - D0 is not reused). Gravity (E4) and the geoPN=3 toy (coordinate inertia, reading the centre's spin) act. f=1. The DR particles are NOT RAY SOURCES through massLedger.darkRotor lens excluded (still gravity sources). THE SHAPE GATES WERE DECLARED BEFORE MEASURING (PHYSICS, wave 283f). NOT CLAIMED: reproducing 47 Tuc, an observational match, a stable shape.
descStruct.observe: Measured (harness tests/exp-w283f-cluster.mjs, canonical tests/out/cluster-w283f.json, dt=0.016): in the window [T_relax, T_end]=[1, 3] x T_out (the orbital time at R_out=40), NaN, retention (r <= 2 R_out, stars and DR separately), the stars' half-mass-radius change, the axis ratio (reduced inertia tensor), |v_rot|/sigma and the toy ledger every 0.25 T_out, reported only as 'shape gates met' / 'not met'. Controls: centre spin 0, no DR, N_rep 80/160 (constant DR mass). NOT CLAIMED: reproducing 47 Tuc, a stable shape.
descStruct.brief: A globular-cluster analogy with a central DFM black hole and stellar-mass dark rotors. Unmet: the shape gates declared before measuring are not met. Out of calibration scope.
descStruct.control: One-tap A/B: side B sets THE CENTRE'S SPIN TO 0 (same configuration, same opt-in). Compare with 🌚 (same physics, same ledger ratio, a galaxy analogy) and 🍇🫐 (47 Tuc transcription and DFM build - different units and initialisation). DO NOT MOVE kFrame (the geoPN=3 entry condition).

massLedger.note: 条件付き台帳(第283便f・原仮定者の裁定〔第72報〕⑥)。⟨m_DR⟩=1 M☉ の行を力学の質量要素として bodies に入れた(代表粒子 40 体 × 53.125 = 2125 単位)。0.1/10 M☉ は比較の列。個数比 20 は宣言値。f★=1。代表粒子は光線の源から外す(lens:"excluded" —— rayHeavy が読む)。較正母集団に入れない。
massLedger.noteEn: A conditional ledger (wave 283f, the originator's ruling in report 72, item 6). The <m_DR> = 1 Msun row is put into the bodies as a dynamical mass component (40 particles x 53.125 = 2125 units); 0.1 and 10 Msun are comparison columns. The count ratio 20 is declared. f_star = 1. The representative particles are not ray sources (lens excluded - read by rayHeavy). Not in the calibration population.
